despegue.corviWelcome:
Welcome to Jezero, LUNA-7!
No air out here, plenty of style.

onboardingDialogs.text:
Welcome, Captain! I'm Corvi, station officer at Octavia E. Butler Landing.
You command mission LUNA-7 in Jezero Crater: explore Mars, collect samples, and survive!

Each day Earth assigns a sample quota (rock, soil, minerals, air) plus base repairs.
Move with WASD or arrows, press E / Space to interact, and M to view the map.
Watch your oxygen and cumulative radiation! Return inside by 17:00—after dark (−80 °C) suit heat drops rapidly. And race to the Bunker if a solar storm hits!

minigameRock.title: Rock Core
minigameRock.instScan: Sweep the scanner over the rocks. Pick the one holding a record of water.
minigameRock.instDrill: Hold click (or Space/E) to drill. Release before red to cool!
minigameRock.instSeal: Press Space, E, or tap when the marker hits green.
minigameRock.wrongRockMsg: Corvi: That rock is uniform. Look for one with layers and spots.
minigameRock.corviFoundLeopard:
Leopard spots!
Perseverance found these in 2024.
minigameRock.overheatRetry: Bit overheated! Cooled down—one more try.
minigameRock.overheatFail: The core shattered from heat. Site remains on the map.
minigameRock.sealRetry: Missed the window. One more try!
minigameRock.sealSuccess: Cheyava Falls core sealed in your tube!

minigameSoil.title: Soil Sample (Regolith)
minigameSoil.instScoop: Tap the mound or press Space/E to load regolith into the sieve.
minigameSoil.instSieve: Swipe left/right to shake the sieve. Only fine grain reaches the tube.
minigameSoil.instSave: Press Space, E, or the button to store fine dust in the tube.
minigameSoil.removePebbleHint: Tap large pebbles to pull them out!
minigameSoil.corviPerchlorates:
This soil has perchlorates:
toxic salts. Gloves on!

minigameMinerals.title: Hydrated Minerals
minigameMinerals.instScan: Sweep the scanner: bright veins trap water inside minerals.
minigameMinerals.instExtract: Tap bright spots along the vein before battery runs dry.
minigameMinerals.instSeal: Press Space, E, or the button inside green to seal.
minigameMinerals.wrongFilterHint: Try another filter (1 UV, 2 IR, or 3 XR) until the hydrated vein lights up.
minigameMinerals.batteryRetry: Scanner battery drained! Recharging for one retry.
minigameMinerals.corviWater:
No surface ice in Jezero,
but these rocks hold water.

minigameAir.title: Air Sample
minigameAir.instConnect: Tap the red valve or press Space/E to attach the tube.
minigameAir.instFill: Hold the valve open and release when the needle enters green.
minigameAir.instClose: Press Close to lock in 6 millibars!
minigameAir.retryMsg: Released outside green (~6 mbar). Try once more!
minigameAir.corviAir:
Mars's air is mostly CO₂.
MOXIE turned it into real oxygen.

minigamePanels.title: Clean Solar Panels
minigamePanels.instBrush: Brush dust off the right solar panel (or press Space/E).
minigamePanels.corviInsight:
Nice! Dust shut down InSight
in 2022. Not on our watch.

minigamePipes.instRotate: Tap each segment (or arrows + Space/E) to connect input and output.
minigamePipes.instBlocked: Tap the clogged filter repeatedly to clear it before rotating!
minigamePipes.corviMoxie:
MOXIE splits oxygen from CO₂
at 800 °C: up to 12 g per hour.

title.tagline: Survive on Mars, gather samples, and shield yourself from solar storms.
title.overwriteWarn: Click again to overwrite saved mission.
howToLines: • Each sol Earth requests samples: check MISSIONS and locate them on your radar (M opens map).
• Your suit burns OXYGEN and builds RADIATION even while working. Return to base before 17:00.
• Minigames allow limited tries (♥). Ruined sites close down and you must find another.
• Missing quota lowers Earth TRUST (★). At 0 stars, the mission is scrubbed.
• When a solar storm alert sounds, sprint to the Bunker. Storm events use real NASA data.
• Learn with Corvi and answer the console quiz for science points and bonus stars.
